title: Chica Mecha Sentada en Íconos de App en Pantalla de iPhone: Render 3D a Escala de Figura
prompt: iPhone 17 Pro Max mockup with Space Black titanium frame, ultra-thin bezels, Dynamic Island. Background shows iOS 26 Japanese locale with Liquid Glass translucent UI, 4×6 grid of authentic Japanese-labeled app icons (メッセージ, 写真, カメラ, Safari, etc.), bottom dock with 4 icons. A medium-sized figurine-scale anime girl with mech-armor sits comfortably across the middle row of app icons as if they were a bench. She is proportionally larger than a single icon (spanning 2-3 icons width) but does not hide the entire UI. Semi-3D anime rendering with soft cel-shading, realistic material textures (metal, glass, fabric). White mechanical armor with black undersuit and glowing blue lines, detailed joints and armor plating. Beautiful anime face with large expressive eyes, friendly smile, relaxed pose looking at viewer with wink. Her legs hang down over the row below, hands rest on knees. Strong realistic contact shadows cast by character onto icon surfaces. Icons remain fixed, immovable, acting as solid glass blocks. Perfect straight-on screenshot angle. High detail, professional studio quality, virtual desktop companion aesthetic.
